owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Can do everything, including every permission added later. Cannot be removed from the last owner.

check.name: Smoke check (automatic)
check.description: Read-only account the server signs in with after every deploy and every night to check that each page opens (CN-016). It can see but never change anything. Its password and two-step code live only on the server and change on every run.

vault.read: See which keys are connected (never the key itself)
vault.write: Add, replace or switch off keys

roles.read: See the roles and what each may do

staff.manage: Add staff, give or take roles, pause an account

audit.read: See the change history (who, when, from where)

security.write: Change sign-in and security settings (2FA, the admin address list, page protection, request limits)

dashboard.read: Open the Dashboard and its waiting work

metrics.read: See the money tiles (Sales and Ordered value)

help.read: Open the admin guides and the manual

media.upload: Upload photos, describe them, place them on products
media.manage: Archive and restore files, clean up unused ones, remake every size

catalogue.read: See products, colours, sizes, categories, fabrics and brands
catalogue.write: Change products, colours, sizes, categories, fabrics, brands, names and links
catalogue.prices: Set sale and compare-at prices of variants
catalogue.publish: Put products on the shop and take them off (only when the publish checklist passes)
catalogue.import: Bring in products from a CSV file or a supplier's link (preview first; a link only makes a draft; nothing is removed)
catalogue.export: Download the catalogue as a CSV file (never cost prices)
catalogue.interest: See who asked to be told when a product is back in stock (their phone or e-mail), and mark them as told
catalogue.sizeAdvice: Train Find My Size and switch a trained version on or off (it never changes a size chart)

inventory.read: See stock per colour and size, warehouses, locations and the ERP connection
inventory.locations: Add, rename and archive warehouses and locations (incl. the damaged bin), link them to ERP warehouses
inventory.erp: Choose where a store's stock and orders come from (our ERP, another ERP, none) and its ERP company and warehouse
inventory.sync: Bring stock from the ERP again now (all or one product), resend waiting ERP documents, check stock against the ERP
inventory.audit: Count a location by barcode and give a reason for each difference (stock itself is corrected in the ERP)

rules.read: See the Smart Rules, their history, clashes and simulations, the notices and the coupons
rules.write: Write rules, notices and coupons and save them as drafts (nothing reaches customers yet)
rules.publish: Publish a rule, pause or end it, and switch a notice on or off
rules.approve: Give the owner's OK for a rule that changes money: delivery charges, set prices, discounts, coupons, COD

combos.read: See the combos, the auto colour-pair rules, their pages and the combo report
combos.write: Make and change combos and combo rules: pieces, pairing, colours, names, templates (prices need their own permission)
combos.publish: Switch a combo or a combo rule on or off, archive it or bring it back, make set photos
combos.prices: Set or change a set price or a pack price (the owner's decision)

delivery.read: See the delivery bands, their charges and hours, and the sub-area list
delivery.charges: Set each band's delivery charge, hours and COD limit, switch a band on or off, choose how the sub-area is charged
delivery.areas: Add places to the sub-area list or take them off (nothing is deleted)
delivery.parcels: See courier parcels: the receiver, the courier's every update, the exceptions, the cost of returned parcels
delivery.book: Book a courier for orders ready to go (never a cancelled, held or in-review order), try a failed booking again
delivery.exceptions: Record what the courier said on the phone: a failed delivery try, an address problem, a lost or damaged parcel
delivery.couriers: Add a courier account, rename it, switch it on or off, archive it (nothing is deleted)
delivery.outcomes: Resolve a parcel the courier called delivered while our records say it came back, and record why a parcel came back (never moves money or changes COD)

system.read: See the Server page: is the background worker alive, and which jobs failed
system.cache: Set how long the cache keeps pages, and clear every cache (Settings → System → Cache)
system.backup: Change the backup settings, and ask for a backup or a restore drill now (Settings → System → Backups)

orders.invoice: Open and print the invoice of any order (it shows the customer's name, phone and address)
orders.invoiceSettings: Change the invoice: what it says, its number pattern, how it prints, its chat picture and issuing
orders.read: See orders, their lines, money, timeline and notes
orders.hold: Put an order on hold with a reason, and release it
orders.cancel: Cancel an order before a courier is booked, with a reason (a paid order only gets a refund request; no money moves)
orders.cancelAfterBooking: Cancel after booking: ask the courier to cancel and record the courier's answer
orders.cancelRequests: Approve or refuse a customer's request to cancel
orders.notes: Write notes and set internal flags on an order

risk.decide: Decide a duplicate-order review: not a duplicate, cancel, hold or ask the customer

orders.merge: Put two open orders of one customer in one parcel (prices and charges stay as they are)
orders.lines: Add a line to an order not yet with the courier, or take out a line added after placing (priced as its product page; nothing else is priced again)
orders.edit: Edit an order not yet with the courier: the customer's name, phone and address, a size at the same price, or take a piece out (with a reason; prices, discounts, the delivery charge and COD never change)
orders.export: Export orders as a CSV file (no personal details)
orders.exportPersonal: Include the customer's name, phone, e-mail and address in an order export

advance.request: Ask a customer for an advance from the order: make the pay link and send it by SMS or WhatsApp, or put a call in the queue (no money moves; COD, prices and charges never change)

reviews.read: See every review with its state (waiting, published, hidden)
reviews.moderate: Publish, hide or refuse a review and mark a verified buyer (approving a photo review also pays the photo reward, only while the owner has switched it on with his own amount)
reviews.write: Add a review the shop collected itself, and bring in a file of reviews

journey.read: See the order messages (steps, channels, limits)

selfConfirm.reply: Record a customer's self-confirm reply (1, 2 or 3)

log.view: See the message log (who got which message, failures and tries)

channels.read: See the message channels (providers, credit, masking name, caps, quiet hours)
channels.write: Change the message channels and limits

consent.view: See who stopped messages (numbers, channels, when) and the stop words
consent.write: Record a customer's stop or start at his request, and change the stop words

templates.read: See the message templates (every SMS, WhatsApp and e-mail text, its preview and where it is used)
templates.write: Change, add or reset a message template's words

payments.view: See payments, what each order still owes and the COD money (customers' payments, collections, statements)
payments.record: Record money received outside the checkout (bKash or Nagad to the shop's number, a bank transfer, cash) — never more than the amount due
payments.door: Record what happened at the door and the money the rider collected (delivered, partly delivered, returned with the charge paid, returned, attempt failed)
payments.partials: Approve or reject the money of a partial delivery
payments.settle: Import a courier's COD statement or a payment service's statement, and mark a checked mismatch as resolved
payments.wallet: Credit or debit a customer's wallet by hand with a reason, and put a wallet entry right with a new one the other way
payments.apology: Give a late-delivery apology credit to a customer's wallet on an order

refunds.request: Ask for a refund on an order (it waits for approval; nothing is paid)
refunds.approve: Approve or reject a refund (the owner's OK before any money goes back)
refunds.execute: Pay out an approved refund — to the wallet, or record the money sent back by hand — or mark its payout failed

payments.advance: Ask a pre-order's advance on an order (paid online by the customer; the rest at the door), within the owner's cap

rules.read: See every fraud and duplicate rule with its switch (the risk rules list)
rules.write: Switch a fraud or duplicate rule on or off (the rule only marks and proposes; nothing is blocked)

fulfilment.print: Print a booked parcel's courier sticker (it shows the receiver's name, phone and address) and a sample sticker
fulfilment.read: See the print run, the recent prints, the handover lists and the picking list, and print the picking list (no customer's details)
fulfilment.handover: Print the rider's handover sheet (it can show the receivers' names) and mark a batch handed over to the courier
fulfilment.pack: Start picking, scan or type each piece, add the packing photo, weigh the parcel and mark an order packed (never books, cancels or edits an order)
fulfilment.photoWaive: Let one order be packed without the required packing photo, with a reason (the owner's override, audited)

returns.view: See the returns and exchanges board and every case
returns.decide: Open, approve, refuse and close exchanges and returns
returns.qc: Receive returned parcels and check each piece (sellable or not)
returns.waive: Waive an exchange delivery charge (with a reason that is logged)

claims.decide: Approve or refuse a customer’s “your mistake” claim on an exchange

returns.handback: Count and note the parcels a courier hands back, and send the return list to the ERP

exchange.approve: Approve an exchange within 72 hours and mark its lines

books.read: See the books, the match with the ERP and the parts of every figure
books.reconcile: Run the books match and write notes on a difference
books.adjust: Put a difference right by a reversing and a new entry (owner’s PIN, reason, the ERP’s matching event)
books.close: Close a week, month or year, or close a month with differences (PIN, logged)

account.read: See Retail’s account at the ERP: the balance owed and the hold

payments.record: Record a payment Retail made to the ERP

customers.read: See the customers and one customer's page (orders, lifetime value, exchanges, support), with the phone number masked; every profile open is logged
customers.phone: See, call and copy a customer's full phone number (each copy and call is logged)
customers.merge: Merge two profiles of the same person, split a merge again, or mark a pair as not the same person (nothing moves or is deleted)
customers.privacy: File and cancel a customer’s request to erase his personal details, and see the requests; only the owner carries one out

seo.read: See the SEO page: which pages search engines may list, the title and description templates, the AI drafts and the structured data
seo.manage: Change the SEO settings, write AI drafts of titles and descriptions, and accept or discard a draft (Website → SEO)

fixedcosts.write: Set a month’s fixed costs (salary, rent, utilities, other)

support.read: Open the support inbox and conversations (with who replied)
support.reply: Reply, write internal notes, take a conversation, mark it solved
support.assign: Give a conversation to someone else

health.read: See Site health: customer problems, the server, speed, the site audit and the smoke test (no customer's details)
